title: Query count bounded by available coordinates
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\Omega$ and $\alpha$ be types, and let $A\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ be a set of available coordinates. For any finite decision tree $T$ with available set $A$ and any input $x:\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\to\Omega$, the number of queries made by $T$ on $x$ is at most $|A|$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite decision tree with available set $A$
